description: This file contains functions for extracting translatable segments from Markdown documents, avoiding code blocks and HTML, and applying translations to those segments. It is used for internationalization (i18n) processing of markdown content.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Parses a Markdown body string to extract segments of translatable text, ignoring code blocks and HTML, returning an array of segments with metadata.

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Takes the original body text and an array of segments with translations, returning the text with segments replaced by their translated versions.
